adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code wraps the hubspotClient.oauth.tokensApi.createToken() call with refreshOAuthTokens(). The refreshOAuthTokens function (in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts) returns either a fetch Response object (when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true) or the result of refreshFunction(). When credential sync is enabled, it returns `response` which is a fetch Response, not the HubspotToken. The code then tries to use `hubspotRefreshToken.expiresIn` and `hubspotRefreshToken.accessToken` which would be undefined on a Response object. This is a real bug - the return type mismatch means synced HubSpot refresh won't work correctly.
